_doc: YouTube channels that keep 24/7 webcams live. Each live video whose title contains a 'match' (case-insensitive, first rule wins) becomes a cam at that rule's place; 'max' caps videos per rule (default 1); titles containing a 'skip' word and unmatched titles are ignored. 'pages' × 50 recent uploads are scanned (1 quota unit per page + 1 per 50 ids, no search quota).

match: パノラマロープウェイ
